Name: Bounces
Description: Set the maximum number of light ray bounces

Name: LDR
Description: Compile with LDR

Name: HDR
Description: Compile with HDR

Name: Both
Description: Compile with HDR and LDR.

Name: Fast
Description: Fast lighting

Name: Final
Description: Increases the quality of light_environment and indirect lighting by spending more time firing rays.

Name: Extra Sky
Description: Trace N times as many rays for indirect light and sky ambient.

Name: Lights File
Description: Load a custom lights (RAD) file in addition to lights.rad and map-specific lights file.

Name: Smooth
Description: Set the smoothing threshold for brush faces without smoothing groups, in degrees.

Name: Luxel Density
Description: Scale down luxels. Maximum value is 1.
Warning: Too low a value can cause lighting errors.

Name: Static Prop Lighting
Description: Generate per-vertex prop_static lighting

Name: Static Prop Lighting Final
Description: Generate per-vertex prop_static lighting (uses higher/final quality processing)

Name: Static Prop Lighting Old
Description: Generate per-vertex prop_static lighting using the old algorithm

Name: Static Prop Bounce
Description: Enable static props to bounce light.

Name: Static Prop Sample Scale
Description: Controls quality of static prop lighting (16 = slow, high quality, 4 = default and 0.25 = fast, low quality).
Warning: Note that adding -final is the same as having -StaticPropSampleScale 16.

Name: Static Prop Polys
Description: Generate lighting on props at polygon precision.

Name: Static Prop Lighting Only
Description: Only perform direct static prop lighting.

Name: No self-shadowing props
Description: Globally disable self-shadowing on static props

Name: Texture Shadows
Description: Generates lightmap shadows from $alphatest and $translucent surfaces of models. (Not brushes)
Warning: Models must be compiled with $casttextureshadows or be listed with forcetextureshadow in the lights file

Name: AO Scale
Description: Scales the amount of baked AO

Name: Threads
Description: Override the number of CPU threads used.

Name: Low Priority
Description: Force VRAD to run as a low-priority process.

Name: Normal Priority
Description: Run process with a normal process priority (be default below normal). Will prevent process from getting run on an efficiency core for certain CPUs
Warning: Using above normal process priority can cause other applications to become slow/unresponsive

Name: Disable Skybox Recursion
Description: Turn off recursion into 3d skybox (skybox shadows on world).

Name: Dump Prop Lightmaps
Description: Dump TGA versions of the lightmaps generated for prop_static models.

Name: No Extra
Description: Disable supersampling. This will lead to blockier, less accurate lighting

Name: Verbose
Description: Turn on verbose output for debug purposes.

Name: Ambient Occlusion
Description: Enhanced light baking that improves shading of corners and crevices, resulting in better shadow defintition and accuracy. Samples are automatically adjusted for -fast and -final mode

Name: Ambient Occlusion Radius
Description: Default 32

Name: Ambient Occlusion Scale
Description: Scale the strength of the ambient occlusion effect. Default 0.5

Name: Force Texture Shadows
Description: Enable texture shadows on all props without needing to specify them in a .rad file

Name: Patch Lightmap Size
Description: Set minimum lightmap size for patches (default is 16). This controls how faces with lower lightmap scales get subdivided for bounced lighting. Lower values will subdivide more, at the cost of increased compile time and memory usage. This may sometimes solve issues with thin surfaces obstructed by geometry not receiving light

Name: Reflectivity Scale
Description: Scale reflectivity (amount of light bounced off surfaces)

Name: Soft Light Sample Multiplier
Description: Control sample multiplier for soft lights. Defaults are 1, 0.25 on -fast, 4 on -final

Name: Static Prop Sample Scale
Description: Controls sample multiplier for prop vertex lighting (default is 1). Defaults to 4 with -final, which will slightly increase compile times. However this will improve quality of prop lighting in areas starved of sunlight or bounced surfaces

Name: Static Props can Shadow Ambient Cubes
Description: Vertex lighting on static props will contribute to nearby ambient cubes. -StaticPropLighting does not need to be enabled. Note that this won't solve sunlight applying to entities shadowed by static props, as the engine ignores prop visiblity at runtime

Name: Static Prop Indirect Mode
Description: ficool2's VRAD++ improves static prop vertex lighting by more accurately calculating the falloff of bounce lighting. The same calculation was used in CS:GO. Supply '1' to use the native TF2 calculation, resulting in darker, more harsh lighting. Supply '2' to use the Orangebox calculation, which dispenses with falloff completely resulting in brighter props

Name: Subdivide Faces with Texture Lights
Description: Force subdivision of faces that have texlights. Can create smoother-looking lights from faces but may take longer to compute

Name: Translucent Shadows
Description: Similar to -worldtextureshadows but for $translucent brush textures. Requires -textureshadows and -worldtextureshadows

Name: Use Original Displacement Bounced Light Calculations
Description: ficool2's VRAD++ features slightly improved displacement bounce lighting that's mostly visible on thin and small displacements. Supply this argument to use the original behaviour

Name: World Texture Shadows
Description: Allows $alphatest brush textures to cast proper shadows like props. Requires -textureshadows

Name: Debug: Ambient
Description: When supplied with three RGB values, it will apply a constant light value to every luxel in a map.

Name: Debug: Coring
Description: Scales the light threshold before a luxel is completely unlit. Used to save lightmap data. Default 0.5

Name: Debug: Props
Description: Extra information to assist in the identification of props that cause delays in compilation

Name: Debug: Visualize Ambient Occlusion
Description: Visualize ambient occlusion

Name: Debug: Report Search Paths
Description: Show search paths for assets

Name: Dump Arguments
Description: Dump this tool's arguments to a text file
